# Supplier Security Annex

Organization: Example GmbH
Version: 2.1
Review date: April 2026
Document owner: Procurement Security role

## Supplier Security Controls

Supplier security is documented for critical third party providers. Before onboarding,
the Procurement Security role runs a supplier review with a questionnaire, due diligence
notes, and contractual security requirements. This implemented supplier security
procedure is approved, regularly monitored, and reviewed by the document owner.

| Supplier tier | Required evidence | Review cadence |
|---|---|---|
| critical | questionnaire, contract clause, remediation ticket | annually |
| standard | security questionnaire and owner approval | every two years |

Supplier review evidence is stored in the procurement register and unresolved risks are
reported to the Security Lead role.
